div.p: Expansion performed internally based on codesystem Maximum Provenance Codes v0.1.0 (CodeSystem)
This value set contains 4 concepts

tr.td: A maximum or safe upper limit that a standards body sets for the animal and use it is applied to: in the source template, NRC's safe upper limits (as printed, as greater-than values and per kg BW^0.75 or BW^0.67, except those NRC states only for its reference kitten or queen), NRC's presumed safe maximum for choline, AAFCO's maximums (except while the AAFCO dry matter factor applies) and FEDIAF's nutritional maximums (except one used beyond the life stage it is stated for), and a maximum the source template copies from one of these. A value above it, and not below a minimum set by the applied standard, is `excess`.

button.data-clipboard-text: <coding><system value="https://openanimalnutrition.org/fhir/animal-nutrition/CodeSystem/maximum-provenance-code"/><version value="0.1.0"/><code value="authoritative"/><display value="Authoritative (set by a standards body)"/></coding>
button.title: Click to Copy as Coding

tr.td: Conditional (a standard's figure with a condition the check does not verify)

A standard's figure that is not a maximum for every diet and animal the check covers: a maximum that applies only under a condition the check does not verify (for example a FEDIAF legal maximum, for nutrients added as additives), a maximum used beyond the life stage or reference animal it is stated for, a level a FEDIAF footnote states to be safe, or an AAFCO maximum while the AAFCO dry matter factor applies. A value above it is not `excess`.

tr.td: Template-set (set or computed by the source template)
